rationale: The agent verified identity via the provided email and matched it to a single user ID before proceeding. It used read-only tools to gather order details and listed prior addresses for the user to select, accommodating the user’s preference not to reveal the address explicitly. Before making any changes, the agent clearly stated the intended updates and obtained explicit confirmation. It then executed address updates only on pending orders using the appropriate tool, and the tool responses confirm the address changes for those orders. The agent did not attempt to modify delivered orders and gave accurate final confirmation. Minor uncertainty remains about one order’s status (#W1994898), but the agent only updated those it identified as pending and succeeded per tool outputs. The user’s default address was not changed, but the user did not request that explicitly in the conversation. Overall, the actions align with policy and the request was completed correctly.
